video_title: Why This Season Is MASSIVE For The Wolves & Ant Edwards

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota Timberwolves' arena renovation and financial challenges
quotes.excerpt: The Target Center got a renovation about five years ago and it went from being a bottom five arena

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Here is the problem that the Wolves are in. You have to be careful about doing a limited renovation of an arena because certainly there are arenas that have been renovated that are in great condition. But the Target Center got a renovation about five years ago and it went from being a bottom five arena to being a bottom five arena.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: I was wondering how much of an upgrade you were going to give them.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: It is not a dump, but the bones of it don't have the amenities that are common for NBA franchises.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota Timberwolves' financial constraints and luxury tax concerns
quotes.excerpt: They paid a lot of money the last couple years, paid a ton in tax

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: They paid a lot of money the last couple years, paid a ton in tax and they are not really in position to squeeze more money out of their own owner of their arena because they just had a publicly supported arena renovation a couple of years ago. The only way you are getting a totally new arena situation is probably if you pay for it yourself.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: The roster as of now without a starting power forward on it, which I don't know if they can fix that or not, but right now they are set to pay $25.5 million in tax this year.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' upcoming contract extension and Tim Connelly's role
quotes.excerpt: Ant Edwards is due a contract extension, he is eligible for an extension next summer.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Ant Edwards is due a contract extension, he is eligible for an extension next summer. So this is a very important year. Additionally, Tim Connelly, their general manager, who really helped, put the pieces in place to have this team have its couple of two or three of its best years of its franchise history.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: The first big win of the Lorie A-Rod era was getting Tim Connelly.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Connelly's contract status and phantom equity bonus
quotes.excerpt: He is in the last year of his contract. If he wanted to, I'm sure he could sign an extension.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Tim Connelly is in the last year of his contract. If he wanted to, I'm sure he could sign an extension. He has not signed the extension. Here is the other thing: when Tim Connelly was brought on board, he was given something called phantom equity. He was basically given a stake in the team, but he didn't actually get shares of the team, he got the equivalent of shares of the team that if he completed his contract, he would get a giant bonus. That bonus is in the five figures and it is not 10 million. It is a very sizable bonus.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: That was the whole point, that and making room to sign A-Rod was the whole point of the maneuvering they did this summer.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Rumors of Minnesota Timberwolves moving to the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: There was a Twitter account, X account, that announced that the Wolves are very soon going to move

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Over the last few days, there was a Twitter account, X account, that announced that the Wolves are very soon going to move to the Eastern Conference and it is going to be great, Ant Edwards is not going to have to deal with Victor Wembanyama. That trickled into my world when producers at ESPN were like, are the Wolves going to be in the Eastern Conference in the next eight minutes? Because it was a completely irresponsible post.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: By a guy who nobody's ever seen in person.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Potential NBA expansion and conference realignment logistics
quotes.excerpt: If the NBA expands and if the NBA expands for two teams, which both things I would say are probable

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: If the NBA expands and if the NBA expands for two teams, which both things I would say are probable, but are not a certainty yet, if that happens, there will be a need to move one team to the Eastern Conference. If it's also Vegas and Seattle, which they've already said it's Vegas and Seattle. So the NBA will need to move one team to the Eastern Conference if they even remain in a 16-16 conference alignment.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: The goal is to be on the level with the Thunder and the Spurs and that's going to be tough to do.
